purpose: Retro Chat and Memes visual studies. Study 02 was selected for the collection; production refinements and exports are recorded in production-prompts.json. Native generation size is 1254px, exported to 2048px.

studies.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original raster artwork for a repeating Android chat wallpaper, Retro Chat study 01.
Create a square 2048 by 2048 pixel seamless repeating pattern of dense, crisp, charming monochrome outline doodles on a genuinely transparent background. Black ink only; all spaces and interiors of outline drawings must be transparent, not white-filled. Preserve a real alpha channel. No paper, colored backdrop, shadows, gradients, border, title, watermark, or UI mockup.
Art direction: nostalgic classic instant messengers, cozy quirky character-rich caricatures. Include repeatedly varied recognizable caricatures of the AIM/AOL running man, eight-petaled ICQ flower, paired MSN Messenger buddy silhouettes, Yahoo Messenger smiling messenger character, old IRC chat windows, tiny buddy-list windows, speech bubbles, pixel cursors, away-status signs. Give the running figures playful energetic poses while preserving their iconic running-man silhouettes. Mix sizes and gentle rotations organically without rows or a grid.
Density and scale: this entire square will repeat every 512 logical pixels, with roughly 8 to 10 small recognizable subjects across a 360-pixel-wide phone. Aim roughly 110 to 140 main/secondary small drawings throughout the full square; most are 70 to 170 image pixels wide. Fill remaining gaps densely with tiny dots, sparkles, small bubbles, status dots and pointers. Balanced all-over packing, no large blank areas, no oversized focal subject. Clean consistent black outlines approximately 3 to 4 pixels thick at 2048 resolution, rounded and antialiased, enough clear interiors for recognition after reduction. Occasional solid accents but predominantly outline drawing.
Text: a few small accurately spelled fragments only, "BRB", "AFK", "IRC", and "LOL", integrated into tiny windows or bubbles. No long phrases or extra lettering.
Seamless construction: motifs at each boundary must continue at the opposite boundary so a 2 by 2 repeat has no visible seams, blank gutters, or obvious grid. Distribute subjects fully to all edges.
Deliver just the finished transparent square artwork, ready for browser preview and later theme tinting.

The rage-comic faces must be recognizable, not generic emoji or interchangeable smiling faces. Mix small busts, faces, full cats and abbreviated reaction poses, at gently varied angles.
Density and scale: this square will repeat every 512 logical pixels, with roughly 8 to 10 small subjects across a 360-pixel-wide phone. Aim roughly 110 to 140 main/secondary small drawings throughout the full square; most are 70 to 170 image pixels wide. Fill the gaps with tiny sparkles, reaction marks, pixel hearts, small cursors, dots and little comic bursts. Organic closely packed all-over composition, no rows, no blank corridors, no oversized hero face. Consistent crisp black outline, roughly 3 to 4 pixels at 2048 resolution, rounded antialiasing. Preserve distinctive expression details, avoiding excessive hatching or heavy solid black clusters.
Text: very occasional small accurately spelled "LOL" and "OK" only. No full meme captions or extra lettering.
Seamless construction: motifs crossing boundaries continue correctly at opposite edges, with no seam, blank gutter or obvious grid in a 2 by 2 repeat.
Deliver just the finished transparent square artwork, ready for browser preview and later theme tinting.

Edit this Retro Chat wallpaper into a denser SECOND study. Preserve the crisp monochrome nostalgic messenger caricature style, genuine transparent background, and all-transparent interiors. The single intended change is SUBJECT SCALE / DENSITY: shrink each doodle and its stroke to about 60 percent of its current relative size, then draw additional varied motifs in the freed space. Aim 12 to 14 small principal subjects across the whole square and roughly 150 to 180 recognizable main/secondary subjects total, plus many tiny fillers. A phone showing 70 percent of the tile width should show about 8 to 10 main subjects across. Do not achieve this by repeating the entire first study in quadrants; compose one varied organic large tile. Keep recognizable AIM/AOL running men, ICQ flowers, MSN buddies, smiling Yahoo messenger figures, IRC windows, buddy lists, cursors and small BRB/AFK/IRC/LOL fragments. Preserve thin consistent lines and legible silhouettes. Make all four edges join seamlessly with their opposite edges: wrapped subjects must align with their continuations, with no cropped mismatched parts or blank gutters. Request 2048 by 2048 square pixels with a real alpha channel. No white fills or white backdrop; only black linework on transparent pixels. Output only the artwork.
